turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
Yes, we do ship internationally to various destinations across North America, Europe, Australia, and select worldwide markets. All available shipping options for your location will be displayed at checkout 🙂

Regarding customs and duties, customers are responsible for paying any applicable taxes, customs fees, or duties in addition to the purchase price of the goods.

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
ers without custom or pre-ordered items are typically processed within 2 to 3 business days. Once your order ships, standard delivery times vary by destination:

US Addresses: 3 to 7 business days, depending on your region 🙂
Canadian Addresses: 2 to 14 business days, depending on your province or territory
International Destinations: 14 to 20 business days

Please note that business days exclude weekends and holidays, and transit times begin once the order has shipped.

turns.q: What's your return and refund policy?
turns.replyTail:
All of our sales are final, meaning we are unable to accept returns, exchanges, or order cancellations once an order has been placed 🙂 You do have a 30-minute grace period right after placing your order to make address updates through your order dashboard if needed.

If you receive an item that is damaged or defective, please let us know so we can review it under our 30-day warranty policy.

turns.q: What's your warranty policy on defective items?
turns.replyTail:
Under our warranty policy for damaged or defective items (orders placed starting January 30, 2026, automatically include a free 1-year warranty), you are eligible for:

A replacement (if the exact item is in stock) 🙂
Or store credit for the amount paid for the item

Please note that refunds are not offered for defective goods. To file a claim, simply provide your order number, a picture or video of the item showing the issue, and a description of the defect.
